data.name: Ashil
data.gender_notes: Ashil is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is little in age or in size, or the one who is born in the night, or the one who resembles the moon or the sun. The name Ashil carries the meaning “Little One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ashil usually hope their child will grow to embody little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the belief in the unity and oneness of Allah (God) and the connection between the creator and the creation. The name Ashil is a reminder of the humility and dependency on Allah and the recognition of the divine power and wisdom.
data.etymology: Ashil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ashil total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: أشيل
in_arabic.meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي يعني الشديد والمتين
in_arabic.long_meaning: أشيل هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من الجذر اللغوي 'أ-ش-ي-ل' والذي يعني الشديد والمتين. وقد ورد هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في سياق وصفي للأنبياء والرسل الذين تحملوا أعباء الرسالة النبوية بجد ومتانة. يعتبر اسم أشيل من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القوة والصلابة، مما يجعله محبوبًا لدى الكثيرين في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: اشیل
in_urdu.meaning: اشیل کا مطلب ہے مضبوط اور پختہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: اشیل ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے مضبوط اور پختہ۔ یہ نام عربی جڑ 'أ-ش-ي-ل' سے ماخوذ ہے، جو قرآن کریم میں انبیاء و رسل کے صفات کے طور پر بیان کیا گیا ہے جو رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کی دعوت کو مضبوطی سے تھامے ہوئے تھے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے، یہ نام طاقت، ثابت قدمی اور روحانی قوت کا اظہار کرتا ہے

in_english.name: Ashil
in_english.meaning: Strong and robust, derived from Arabic roots
in_english.long_meaning: Ashil is a masculine name originating from Arabic roots. Etymologically derived from the root 'أ-ش-ي-ل', it signifies strength and robustness. This root is referenced in the Quranic context, describing the steadfastness of prophets and messengers. In Islamic tradition, Ashil connotes qualities of resilience, spiritual fortitude, and determination. Historically, the name has been appreciated across Muslim cultures for its powerful connotations, reflecting a personality that is steadfast and strong-willed. In contemporary usage, Ashil remains a meaningful choice for parents seeking a name that embodies spiritual and moral strength
